entry.title: ACID Krush Red Cameroon
experienceTags: Pairings: Iced tea, coffee or cola
entry.summaryHtml: Sweet tea, aromatic herbs, mild Cameroon spice, earth and toasted nuttiness lead the profile. The infusion is sweet without becoming syrupy, while the Cameroon wrapper adds dry toast and gentle spice underneath. The 4×32 format concentrates the flavour into a quick, aromatic smoke with enough tobacco character to keep the sweetness balanced.
entry.noteHtml: Firmin Cigars currently lists the individual cigar at A$14.80.

note: Add Drew Estate ACID Krush Red Cameroon to Coronets & Cigarillos. Personal tasting sets Flavour 8 and Quality/Construction 7, with sweet tea as the standout flavour. Firmin lists the individual cigar at A$14.80; Cigar Hut lists the exact 4×32 product in tin packages. Value remains automatic.
